W01a.title: Provide
W01a.bottom: himself a lamb for a burnt offering...
W01a.verse: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

W01b.title: Create
W01b.verse: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

W01c.title: Walk
W01c.bottom: and he was not; for God took him.
W01c.verse: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.

W02a.title: Bless
W02a.top: I will not let thee go,
W02a.verse: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

W02b.title: With
W02b.top: And, behold, I am with thee,
W02b.bottom: and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest...
W02b.verse: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.

W03a.title: Deliver
W03a.top: And I am come down to deliver them
W03a.bottom: out of the hand of the Egyptians...
W03a.verse: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

W03b.title: Good
W03b.bottom: but God meant it unto good...
W03b.verse: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

W03c.title: Strength
W03c.top: The LORD is my strength and song,
W03c.bottom: and he is become my salvation...
W03c.verse: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

W04a.title: Presence
W04a.top: My presence shall go with thee,
W04a.bottom: and I will give thee rest.
W04a.verse: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.

W04b.title: Glory
W04b.bottom: I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.
W04b.verse: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.

W05a.title: Holy
W05a.top: For I am the LORD your God...
W05a.bottom: ye shall be holy; for I am holy...
W05a.verse: For I am the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

W05b.title: Atone
W05b.top: For the life of the flesh is in the blood:
W05b.bottom: ...it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.
W05b.verse: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.

W06a.title: Keep
W06a.verse: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:

W06b.title: Liberty
W06b.top: ...and proclaim liberty throughout all the land
W06b.verse: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.

W07a.title: Look
W07a.bottom: when he looketh upon it, shall live.
W07a.verse: And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.

W08a.title: Bread
W08a.top: ...man doth not live by bread only,
W08a.bottom: but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD...
W08a.verse: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.

W09a.title: Courage
W09a.top: Be strong and of a good courage;
W09a.bottom: ...the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
W09a.verse: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

W10a.title: Serve
W10a.top: ...choose you this day whom ye will serve;
W10a.bottom: ...as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.
W10a.verse: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.

W10b.title: Refuge
W10b.verse: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.

W11a.title: Heart
W11a.top: ...for man looketh on the outward appearance,
W11a.bottom: but the LORD looketh on the heart.
W11a.verse: But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the Lord seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.

W11b.title: Redeem
W11b.top: If thou wilt redeem it, redeem it:
W11b.bottom: ...And he said, I will redeem it.
W11b.verse: And I thought to advertise thee, saying, Buy it before the inhabitants, and before the elders of my people. If thou wilt redeem it, redeem it: but if thou wilt not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know: for there is none to redeem it beside thee; and I am after thee. And he said, I will redeem it.

W11c.title: Speak
W11c.verse: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.

W12a.title: Kingdom
W12a.top: And thine house and thy kingdom
W12a.bottom: shall be established for ever before thee...
W12a.verse: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.

W12b.title: Battle
W12b.bottom: and he will give you into our hands.
W12b.verse: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD’s, and he will give you into our hands.

W13a.title: Kindness
W13a.top: Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness
W13a.bottom: ...and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.
W13a.verse: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father’s sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.

W13b.title: Wisdom
W13b.verse: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?

W14a.title: Oil
W14a.verse: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.

W14b.title: Double
W14b.top: ...I pray thee, let a double portion
W14b.bottom: of thy spirit be upon me.
W14b.verse: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.

W14c.title: Fire
W14c.top: Then the fire of the LORD fell,
W14c.verse: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.

W14d.title: Still
W14d.verse: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.

W15a.title: Heal
W15a.top: I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears:
W15a.verse: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the LORD.

W15b.title: Found
W15b.top: I have found the book of the law
W15b.bottom: in the house of the LORD.
W15b.verse: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

W16a.title: Thank
W16a.top: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good;
W16a.bottom: for his mercy endureth for ever.
W16a.verse: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

W17a.title: Humble
W17a.top: If my people... shall humble themselves, and pray,
W17a.bottom: ...then will I hear from heaven... and will heal their land.
W17a.verse: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

W18a.title: Return
W18a.top: ...the LORD your God is gracious and merciful,
W18a.bottom: and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.
W18a.verse: For if ye turn again unto the LORD, your brethren and your children shall find compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land: for the LORD your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.

W19a.title: Joy
W19a.bottom: for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
W19a.verse: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.

W19b.title: Build
W19b.top: The God of heaven, he will prosper us;
W19b.bottom: therefore we his servants will arise and build...
W19b.verse: Then answered I them, and said unto them, The God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.

W19c.title: Time
W19c.top: ...who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom
W19c.bottom: for such a time as this?
W19c.verse: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father’s house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?

W20a.title: Redeemer
W20a.top: For I know that my redeemer liveth,
W20a.bottom: and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth.
W20a.verse: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

W21a.title: Gold
W21a.top: But he knoweth the way that I take:
W21a.bottom: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
W21a.verse: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

W21b.title: Delight
W21b.top: But his delight is in the law of the LORD;
W21b.bottom: and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
W21b.verse: But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

W22a.title: Shepherd
W22a.verse: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

W23a.title: Still
W23a.top: Be still, and know that I am God:
W23a.bottom: I will be exalted among the heathen...
W23a.verse: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

W23b.title: Light
W23b.top: The LORD is my light and my salvation;
W23b.verse: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

W23c.title: Taste
W23c.top: O taste and see that the LORD is good:
W23c.bottom: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
W23c.verse: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

W24a.title: Wash
W24a.top: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean:
W24a.bottom: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
W24a.verse: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

W24b.title: Thirst
W24b.top: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee:
W24b.verse: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

W25a.title: Refuge
W25a.top: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress:
W25a.bottom: my God; in him will I trust.
W25a.verse: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

W25b.title: Dwell
W25b.top: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High
W25b.bottom: shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
W25b.verse: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

W26a.title: Worship
W26a.top: O come, let us worship and bow down:
W26a.bottom: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
W26a.verse: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

W26b.title: Enter
W26b.top: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving,
W26b.bottom: and into his courts with praise...
W26b.verse: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

W27a.title: Lamp
W27a.top: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet,
W27a.bottom: and a light unto my path.
W27a.verse: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

W27b.title: Made
W27b.bottom: for I am fearfully and wonderfully made...
W27b.verse: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

W28a.title: Praise
W28a.top: Let every thing that hath breath
W28a.bottom: praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
W28a.verse: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.

W28b.title: Direct
W28b.top: In all thy ways acknowledge him,
W28b.bottom: and he shall direct thy paths.
W28b.verse: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

W29a.title: Wisdom
W29a.top: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold!
W29a.bottom: and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
W29a.verse: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!

W29b.title: Tower
W29b.top: The name of the LORD is a strong tower:
W29b.bottom: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
W29b.verse: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

W29c.title: Season
W29c.top: To every thing there is a season,
W29c.bottom: and a time to every purpose under the heaven.
W29c.verse: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:

W30a.title: Send
W30a.top: Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?
W30a.bottom: Then said I, Here am I; send me.
W30a.verse: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.

W30b.title: Immanuel
W30b.top: Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son,
W30b.bottom: and shall call his name Immanuel.
W30b.verse: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

W30c.title: Reason
W30c.top: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD:
W30c.bottom: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow...
W30c.verse: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

W31a.title: Peace
W31a.top: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace,
W31a.bottom: whose mind is stayed on thee...
W31a.verse: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

W31b.title: Wonderful
W31b.top: ...and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor,
W31b.bottom: The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
W31b.verse: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

W32a.title: Wait
W32a.top: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength;
W32a.bottom: they shall mount up with wings as eagles...
W32a.verse: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

W32b.title: Comfort
W32b.top: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people,
W32b.verse: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.

W32c.title: Called
W32c.top: Fear not: for I have redeemed thee,
W32c.bottom: I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
W32c.verse: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.

W32d.title: Wounded
W32d.top: But he was wounded for our transgressions,
W32d.bottom: ...and with his stripes we are healed.
W32d.verse: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

W33a.title: Come
W33a.top: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters...
W33a.bottom: ...come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
W33a.verse: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

W33b.title: Arise
W33b.top: Arise, shine; for thy light is come,
W33b.bottom: and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
W33b.verse: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.

W34a.title: Find
W34a.top: And ye shall seek me, and find me,
W34a.bottom: when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
W34a.verse: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.

W34b.title: Clay
W34b.top: Behold, as the clay is in the potter’s hand,
W34b.bottom: so are ye in mine hand...
W34b.verse: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD. Behold, as the clay is in the potter’s hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.

W34c.title: Hard
W34c.top: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth...
W34c.bottom: ...there is nothing too hard for thee.
W34c.verse: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:

W35a.title: New
W35a.bottom: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
W35a.verse: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

W35b.title: Call
W35b.top: Call unto me, and I will answer thee,
W35b.bottom: and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
W35b.verse: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.

W36a.title: Turn
W36a.top: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth...
W36a.verse: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord GOD: wherefore turn yourselves, and live ye.

W36b.title: Spirit
W36b.top: ...and I will put a new spirit within you;
W36b.bottom: and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh...
W36b.verse: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:

W37a.title: Stand
W37a.top: And I sought for a man among them,
W37a.bottom: that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap...
W37a.verse: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.

W37b.title: Search
W37b.top: Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep,
W37b.verse: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.

W38a.title: River
W38a.top: ...whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live:
W38a.bottom: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish...
W38a.verse: And it shall come to pass, that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.

W38b.title: Faithful
W38b.top: ...but they could find none occasion nor fault;
W38b.verse: Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom; but they could find none occasion nor fault; forasmuch as he was faithful, neither was there any error or fault found in him.

W39a.title: Restore
W39a.top: And I will restore to you
W39a.bottom: the years that the locust hath eaten...
W39a.verse: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.

W39b.title: Fish
W39b.top: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish
W39b.verse: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

W39c.title: Pour
W39c.top: ...I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh;
W39c.bottom: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy...
W39c.verse: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:

W40a.title: Mercy
W40a.top: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity...
W40a.bottom: ...he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.
W40a.verse: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.

W40b.title: Vision
W40b.top: Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables,
W40b.bottom: that he may run that readeth it.
W40b.verse: And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.

W40c.title: Rejoice
W40c.top: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save,
W40c.bottom: he will rejoice over thee with joy...
W40c.verse: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.

W41a.title: Fishers
W41a.top: And he saith unto them, Follow me,
W41a.bottom: and I will make you fishers of men.
W41a.verse: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.

W41b.title: King
W41b.bottom: he is just, and having salvation; lowly...
W41b.verse: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.

W41c.title: Daily
W41c.verse: Give us this day our daily bread.

W41d.title: Shine
W41d.top: Let your light so shine before men,
W41d.bottom: that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father...
W41d.verse: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

W42a.title: Go
W42a.top: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations,
W42a.bottom: baptizing them in the name of the Father...
W42a.verse: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:

W42b.title: Faith
W42b.top: ...If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed...
W42b.verse: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

W42c.title: Rock
W42c.top: ...and upon this rock I will build my church;
W42c.bottom: and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
W42c.verse: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

W43a.title: Deep
W43a.bottom: and let down your nets for a draught.
W43a.verse: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.

W43b.title: Saviour
W43b.top: For unto you is born this day in the city of David
W43b.bottom: a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
W43b.verse: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

W43c.title: Possible
W43c.bottom: all things are possible to him that believeth.
W43c.verse: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.

W44a.title: Free
W44a.top: If the Son therefore shall make you free,
W44a.verse: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

W44b.title: Found
W44b.top: For this my son was dead, and is alive again;
W44b.bottom: he was lost, and is found.
W44b.verse: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.

W44c.title: Born
W44c.top: Verily, verily, I say unto thee,
W44c.bottom: Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
W44c.verse: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

W44d.title: Water
W44d.top: ...whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him
W44d.verse: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

W45a.title: Abide
W45a.top: Abide in me, and I in you.
W45a.bottom: As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine...
W45a.verse: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

W45b.title: Finished
W45b.bottom: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
W45b.verse: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

W45c.title: Cast
W45c.top: Cast the net on the right side of the ship,
W45c.verse: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.

W45d.title: Way
W45d.top: I am the way, the truth, and the life:
W45d.bottom: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
W45d.verse: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

W45e.title: Power
W45e.bottom: after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you...
W45e.verse: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

W46a.title: Gift
W46a.top: For the wages of sin is death;
W46a.bottom: but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
W46a.verse: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

W46b.title: Saved
W46b.top: Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ,
W46b.bottom: and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
W46b.verse: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

W46c.title: Grace
W46c.verse: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:

W47a.title: Renew
W47a.top: And be not conformed to this world:
W47a.bottom: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind...
W47a.verse: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

W47b.title: Confess
W47b.top: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus,
W47b.verse: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.

W47c.title: Together
W47c.top: And we know that all things work together for good
W47c.verse: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

W48a.title: Grace
W48a.top: My grace is sufficient for thee:
W48a.bottom: for my strength is made perfect in weakness.
W48a.verse: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

W48b.title: Victory
W48b.top: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory
W48b.verse: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

W48c.title: Fruit
W48c.top: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace,
W48c.verse: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

W49a.title: Faith
W49a.top: For by grace are ye saved through faith;
W49a.bottom: and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God.
W49a.verse: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:

W49b.title: Rejoice
W49b.verse: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

W49c.title: Press
W49c.top: I press toward the mark for the prize
W49c.bottom: of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
W49c.verse: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

W49d.title: Armour
W49d.top: Put on the whole armour of God,
W49d.bottom: that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
W49d.verse: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

W50a.title: Word
W50a.top: For the word of God is quick, and powerful,
W50a.bottom: and sharper than any twoedged sword...
W50a.verse: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

W50b.title: Bold
W50b.top: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace,
W50b.bottom: that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
W50b.verse: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

W50c.title: Finish
W50c.top: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course,
W50c.verse: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:

W51a.title: Run
W51a.bottom: the race that is set before us.
W51a.verse: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

W51b.title: Faith
W51b.top: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for,
W51b.bottom: the evidence of things not seen.
W51b.verse: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

W51c.title: Cast
W51c.top: Casting all your care upon him;
W51c.verse: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

W52a.title: Amen
W52a.verse: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.

W52b.title: Door
W52b.top: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock:
W52b.bottom: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in...
W52b.verse: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

W52c.title: Water
W52c.bottom: let him take the water of life freely.
W52c.verse: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.

W52d.title: Worthy
W52d.top: Worthy is the Lamb that was slain
W52d.bottom: to receive power, and riches, and wisdom...
W52d.verse: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.

D648.title: Tend
D648.bottom: thou knowest that I love thee... Feed my sheep.
D648.verse: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

X001.title: Stop
X001.top: Sober up as you ought, and stop sinning;
X001.bottom: for some of you are ignorant of God...
X001.verse: Sober up as you ought, and stop sinning; for some of you are ignorant of God. I say this to your shame.

X002.title: Go
X002.top: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way;
X002.bottom: and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee.
X002.verse: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.

X003.title: Repent
X003.top: Repent ye therefore, and be converted,
X003.bottom: that your sins may be blotted out...
X003.verse: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;

X004.title: Build
X004.top: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves
X004.bottom: on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost...
X004.verse: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,

D271.title: Rebuild
D271.top: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David
D271.bottom: that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof...
D271.verse: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:

D365.title: Seed
D365.top: between thy seed and her seed;
D365.bottom: it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
D365.verse: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.

D366.title: Ark
D366.top: And the LORD said unto Noah,
D366.bottom: Come thou and all thy house into the ark...
D366.verse: And the LORD said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.

D003.title: Covenant
D003.top: I do set my bow in the cloud,
D003.bottom: and it shall be for a token of a covenant...
D003.verse: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

D367.title: Depart
D367.top: Get thee out of thy country...
D367.bottom: unto a land that I will shew thee:
D367.verse: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father’s house, unto a land that I will shew thee:

D004.title: Shield
D004.top: Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield,
D004.verse: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.

D005.title: Almighty
D005.bottom: walk before me, and be thou perfect.
D005.verse: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.

D368.title: Judge
D368.bottom: of all the earth do right?
D368.verse: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?

D369.title: Clasp
D369.top: the men laid hold upon his hand...
D369.bottom: the LORD being merciful unto him...
D369.verse: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the LORD being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.

D007.title: Visit
D007.verse: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.

D008.title: Lead
D008.verse: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master’s brethren.

D370.title: Flourish
D370.top: For now the LORD hath made room for us,
D370.bottom: and we shall be fruitful in the land.
D370.verse: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.

D371.title: Bounty
D371.top: God give thee of the dew of heaven,
D371.bottom: and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:
D371.verse: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:

D372.title: Listen
D372.verse: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

D373.title: Keeper
D373.top: The LORD watch between me and thee,
D373.bottom: when we are absent one from another.
D373.verse: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.

D374.title: Altar
D374.top: I will make there an altar unto God,
D374.bottom: who answered me in the day of my distress...
D374.verse: And let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.

D375.title: Lineage
D375.verse: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.

D011.title: Rescue
D011.top: And Reuben heard it, and he delivered
D011.verse: And Reuben heard it , and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.

D376.title: Humility
D376.top: And Judah acknowledged them, and said,
D376.bottom: She hath been more righteous than I...
D376.verse: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.

D012.title: Prosper
D012.top: And the LORD was with Joseph,
D012.bottom: and he was a prosperous man...
D012.verse: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

D377.title: Fruitful
D377.top: For God hath caused me to be fruitful
D377.bottom: in the land of my affliction.
D377.verse: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.

D378.title: Remorse
D378.top: We are verily guilty concerning our brother,
D378.bottom: in that we saw the anguish of his soul...
D378.verse: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.

D379.title: Yearn
D379.top: for his bowels did yearn upon his brother:
D379.bottom: and he sought where to weep...
D379.verse: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.

D380.title: Surety
D380.top: let thy servant abide instead of the lad
D380.bottom: a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up...
D380.verse: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.

D013.title: Preserve
D013.verse: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.

D381.title: Nourish
D381.bottom: and his brethren, and all his father's household...
D381.verse: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father’s household, with bread, according to their families.

D382.title: Sceptre
D382.top: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah...
D382.bottom: until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering...
D382.verse: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.

D383.title: Words
D383.top: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth,
D383.bottom: and teach thee what thou shalt say.
D383.verse: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.

D017.title: Belong
D017.top: And I will take you to me for a people,
D017.bottom: and I will be to you a God...
D017.verse: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

D384.title: Miracle
D384.top: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh,
D384.bottom: This is the finger of God...
D384.verse: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This is the finger of God: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.

D018.title: Declare
D018.verse: And in very deed for this cause have I raised thee up, for to shew in thee my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.

D385.title: Radiance
D385.top: but all the children of Israel
D385.verse: They saw not one another, neither rose any from his place for three days: but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.

D386.title: Passover
D386.top: and when I see the blood,
D386.verse: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt.

D387.title: Pillar
D387.top: And the LORD went before them by day
D387.bottom: in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way...
D387.verse: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:

D388.title: Manna
D388.top: It is manna... This is the bread
D388.bottom: which the LORD hath given you to eat.
D388.verse: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat.

D389.title: Steady
D389.top: Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands...
D389.bottom: and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
D389.verse: But Moses’ hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.

D020.title: Wings
D020.top: ...how I bare you on eagles' wings,
D020.verse: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles’ wings, and brought you unto myself.

D390.title: Master
D390.top: I love my master, my wife,
D390.bottom: and my children; I will not go out free:
D390.verse: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:

D022.title: Guard
D022.top: Behold, I send an Angel before thee,
D022.bottom: to keep thee in the way...
D022.verse: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.

D023.title: Meet
D023.top: And there I will meet with thee,
D023.bottom: and I will commune with thee...
D023.verse: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.

D391.title: Veil
D391.top: and the vail shall divide unto you
D391.bottom: between the holy place and the most holy.
D391.verse: And thou shalt hang up the vail under the taches, that thou mayest bring in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony: and the vail shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy.

D392.title: Shoulder
D392.top: and Aaron shall bear their names
D392.bottom: before the LORD upon his two shoulders for a memorial.
D392.verse: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD upon his two shoulders for a memorial.

D024.title: Know
D024.bottom: that I am the LORD their God...
D024.verse: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.

D393.title: Talent
D393.top: I have filled him with the spirit of God,
D393.bottom: in wisdom... and in all manner of workmanship...
D393.verse: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,

D394.title: Rally
D394.top: Who is on the LORD's side?
D394.verse: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD’s side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.

D026.title: Offer
D026.top: ...every one whom his spirit made willing,
D026.bottom: and they brought the LORD's offering...
D026.verse: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and they brought the LORD’s offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.

D395.title: Incense
D395.top: And he made the holy anointing oil,
D395.bottom: and the pure incense of sweet spices...
D395.verse: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.

D396.title: Complete
D396.top: and, behold, they had done it
D396.bottom: as the LORD had commanded... and Moses blessed them.
D396.verse: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.

D027.title: Fill
D027.top: Then a cloud covered the tent...
D027.bottom: and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
D027.verse: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

D397.title: Salt
D397.top: neither shalt thou suffer the salt
D397.bottom: of the covenant of thy God to be lacking...
D397.verse: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.

D029.title: Pardon
D029.top: ...the priest shall make an atonement for him,
D029.bottom: and it shall be forgiven him.
D029.verse: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD ; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.

D030.title: Burn
D030.top: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar;
D030.verse: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.

D398.title: Thanks
D398.top: If he offer it for a thanksgiving,
D398.bottom: then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving...
D398.verse: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.

D399.title: Sanctify
D399.top: And he poured of the anointing oil
D399.bottom: upon Aaron's head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
D399.verse: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

D400.title: Bow
D400.bottom: they shouted, and fell on their faces.
D400.verse: And there came a fire out from before the LORD, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.

D401.title: Clean
D401.bottom: it is all turned white: he is clean.
D401.verse: Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.

D402.title: Liberate
D402.bottom: and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.
D402.verse: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.

D403.title: Immerse
D403.top: and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh
D403.bottom: in running water, and shall be clean.
D403.verse: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

D032.title: Cleanse
D032.top: ...to cleanse you, that ye may be clean
D032.bottom: from all your sins before the LORD.
D032.verse: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD .

D404.title: Stranger
D404.top: But the stranger that dwelleth with you...
D404.bottom: thou shalt love him as thyself...
D404.verse: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.

D405.title: Chosen
D405.top: I the LORD am holy, and have severed you
D405.bottom: from other people, that ye should be mine.
D405.verse: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the LORD am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.

D406.title: Hallow
D406.top: I will be hallowed among the children of Israel:
D406.bottom: I am the LORD which hallow you,
D406.verse: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the LORD which hallow you,

D034.title: Sabbath
D034.top: ...the seventh day is the sabbath of rest,
D034.verse: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.

D407.title: Sleep
D407.top: And I will give peace in the land,
D407.bottom: and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid...
D407.verse: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

D408.title: Tithe
D408.top: And all the tithe of the land...
D408.bottom: is the LORD's: it is holy unto the LORD.
D408.verse: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD’s: it is holy unto the LORD.

D409.title: Names
D409.top: Take ye the sum of all the congregation...
D409.bottom: with the number of their names...
D409.verse: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their polls;

D410.title: Encamp
D410.top: Every man... shall pitch by his own standard...
D410.bottom: about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.
D410.verse: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father’s house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.

D411.title: Precious
D411.top: Because all the firstborn are mine...
D411.bottom: mine shall they be: I am the LORD.
D411.verse: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the LORD.

D412.title: Burden
D412.top: every one according to his service,
D412.verse: According to the commandment of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the LORD commanded Moses.

D413.title: Commune
D413.top: then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him
D413.bottom: from off the mercy seat... and he spake unto him.
D413.verse: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.

D414.title: Journey
D414.top: At the commandment of the LORD
D414.verse: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the LORD they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.

D415.title: Invite
D415.top: come thou with us, and we will do thee good:
D415.bottom: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.
D415.verse: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses’ father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the LORD said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.

D416.title: Reach
D416.top: Is the LORD's hand waxed short?
D416.bottom: thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass...
D416.verse: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD’s hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.

D039.title: Meekness
D039.top: Now the man Moses was very meek,
D039.bottom: above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.
D039.verse: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)

D417.title: Honey
D417.top: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us
D417.bottom: into this land... which floweth with milk and honey.
D417.verse: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.

D418.title: Reminder
D418.top: that ye may look upon it,
D418.bottom: and remember all the commandments of the LORD, and do them...
D418.verse: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD, and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:

D419.title: Bridge
D419.top: And he stood between the dead and the living;
D419.verse: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

D041.title: Blossom
D041.bottom: was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms...
D041.verse: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.

D420.title: Overflow
D420.top: and with his rod he smote the rock twice:
D420.bottom: and the water came out abundantly...
D420.verse: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.

D421.title: Angel
D421.top: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam,
D421.bottom: and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way...
D421.verse: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.

D422.title: Fulfil
D422.top: hath he said, and shall he not do it?
D422.bottom: or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
D422.verse: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?

D423.title: Garden
D423.top: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob...
D423.bottom: as gardens by the river's side...
D423.verse: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel! As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river’s side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters.

D424.title: Remnant
D424.top: And there was not left a man of them,
D424.bottom: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
D424.verse: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

D044.title: Sheep
D044.bottom: be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
D044.verse: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.

D045.title: Vow
D045.top: If a man vow a vow unto the LORD...
D045.bottom: he shall not break his word...
D045.verse: If a man vow a vow unto the LORD , or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.

D425.title: Refine
D425.top: Every thing that may abide the fire,
D425.bottom: ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean...
D425.verse: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.

D426.title: Fidelity
D426.top: Save Caleb... and Joshua the son of Nun:
D426.bottom: for they have wholly followed the LORD.
D426.verse: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.

D427.title: Onward
D427.top: And Moses wrote their goings out
D427.bottom: according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD...
D427.verse: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.

D046.title: Flee
D046.bottom: that the slayer may flee thither...
D046.verse: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.

D047.title: Carry
D047.bottom: as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went...
D047.verse: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.

D428.title: Fullness
D428.top: these forty years the LORD thy God
D428.bottom: hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.
D428.verse: For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the LORD thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.

D429.title: Embolden
D429.top: But charge Joshua, and encourage him,
D429.bottom: and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people...
D429.verse: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.

D430.title: Pursuit
D430.top: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God,
D430.bottom: thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart...
D430.verse: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.

D048.title: Hear
D048.bottom: The LORD our God is one LORD:
D048.verse: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD :

D431.title: Advocate
D431.top: the LORD was wroth against you to destroy you.
D431.bottom: But the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also.
D431.verse: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the LORD was wroth against you to destroy you. But the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also.

D432.title: Home
D432.top: And ye shall teach them your children,
D432.bottom: speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house...
D432.verse: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

D433.title: Cleave
D433.top: Ye shall walk after the LORD your God,
D433.bottom: ...and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.
D433.verse: Ye shall walk after the LORD your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.

D051.title: Open
D051.top: Thou shalt open thine hand wide
D051.bottom: unto thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy...
D051.verse: For the poor shall never cease out of the land: therefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy, in thy land.

D434.title: Feast
D434.top: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast
D434.verse: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD shall choose: because the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase, and in all the works of thine hands, therefore thou shalt surely rejoice.

D052.title: Prophet
D052.top: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet
D052.verse: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;

D435.title: Ally
D435.top: For the LORD your God is he that goeth with you,
D435.bottom: to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.
D435.verse: For the LORD your God is he that goeth with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.

D053.title: Help
D053.verse: Thou shalt not see thy brother’s ass or his ox fall down by the way, and hide thyself from them: thou shalt surely help him to lift them up again.

D436.title: Glean
D436.bottom: for the fatherless, and for the widow...
D436.verse: When thou cuttest down thine harvest in thy field, and hast forgot a sheaf in the field, thou shalt not go again to fetch it: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow: that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hands.

D054.title: Cry
D054.top: And when we cried unto the LORD...
D054.bottom: the LORD heard our voice, and looked on our affliction...
D054.verse: And when we cried unto the LORD God of our fathers, the LORD heard our voice, and looked on our affliction, and our labour, and our oppression:

D437.title: Overtake
D437.top: And all these blessings shall come on thee,
D437.bottom: and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice...
D437.verse: And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.

D055.title: Reveal
D055.top: The secret things belong unto the LORD our God:
D055.bottom: but those things which are revealed belong unto us...
D055.verse: The secret things belong unto the LORD our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.

D438.title: Assure
D438.top: he will be with thee, he will not fail thee,
D438.bottom: neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
D438.verse: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.

D439.title: Eagle
D439.top: As an eagle stirreth up her nest,
D439.bottom: ...spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them...
D439.verse: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:

D057.title: Arms
D057.top: The eternal God is thy refuge,
D057.bottom: and underneath are the everlasting arms...
D057.verse: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them .

D440.title: Wonders
D440.bottom: for to morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.
D440.verse: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.

D059.title: Shout
D059.top: Joshua said unto the people, Shout;
D059.bottom: for the LORD hath given you the city.
D059.verse: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for the LORD hath given you the city.

D441.title: Disclose
D441.top: My son, give, I pray thee, glory to the LORD...
D441.bottom: and make confession unto him... hide it not from me.
D441.verse: And Joshua said unto Achan, My son, give, I pray thee, glory to the LORD God of Israel, and make confession unto him; and tell me now what thou hast done; hide it not from me.

D442.title: Recite
D442.top: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded,
D442.bottom: which Joshua read not before all the congregation...
D442.verse: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Israel, with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them.

D443.title: Yield
D443.top: And now, behold, we are in thine hand:
D443.bottom: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.
D443.verse: And now, behold, we are in thine hand: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.

D060.title: Fight
D060.top: ...the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man:
D060.bottom: for the LORD fought for Israel.
D060.verse: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the LORD fought for Israel.

D444.title: Perform
D444.top: ...so did Joshua; he left nothing undone
D444.bottom: of all that the LORD commanded Moses.
D444.verse: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.

D061.title: Claim
D061.top: Now therefore give me this mountain...
D061.bottom: if so be the LORD will be with me...
D061.verse: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be the LORD will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.

D445.title: Request
D445.top: Give me a blessing... give me also springs of water.
D445.bottom: And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.
D445.verse: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.

D062.title: Possess
D062.top: How long are ye slack to go to possess the land,
D062.bottom: which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?
D062.verse: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?

D446.title: Fruition
D446.top: There failed not ought of any good thing
D446.bottom: which the LORD had spoken... all came to pass.
D446.verse: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.

D447.title: Memorial
D447.top: ...called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness
D447.bottom: between us that the LORD is God.
D447.verse: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that the LORD is God.

D448.title: Inquire
D448.top: ...the children of Israel asked the LORD, saying,
D448.bottom: Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first...
D448.verse: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the LORD, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?

D449.title: Pity
D449.top: ...then the LORD was with the judge,
D449.bottom: ...for it repented the LORD because of their groanings...
D449.verse: And when the LORD raised them up judges, then the LORD was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the LORD because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.

D450.title: Sunrise
D450.top: But let them that love him be as the sun
D450.bottom: when he goeth forth in his might.
D450.verse: So let all thine enemies perish, O LORD: but let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.

D066.title: Valour
D066.verse: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.

D451.title: Sword
D451.bottom: The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.
D451.verse: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.

D067.title: Rule
D067.top: I will not rule over you...
D067.bottom: the LORD shall rule over you.
D067.verse: And Gideon said unto them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you: the LORD shall rule over you.

D452.title: Calling
D452.top: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave
D452.bottom: my fatness, wherewith by me they honour God and man...
D452.verse: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave my fatness, wherewith by me they honour God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?

D453.title: Renounce
D453.top: And they put away the strange gods from among them,
D453.verse: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.

D068.title: Instruct
D068.top: O my Lord... come again unto us,
D068.bottom: and teach us what we shall do...
D068.verse: Then Manoah intreated the LORD , and said, O my Lord, let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.

D069.title: Revive
D069.bottom: his spirit came again, and he revived...
D069.verse: But God clave an hollow place that was in the jaw, and there came water thereout; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived: wherefore he called the name thereof En-hakkore, which is in Lehi unto this day.

D070.title: Plead
D070.top: O Lord GOD, remember me, I pray thee,
D070.bottom: and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once...
D070.verse: And Samson called unto the LORD , and said, O Lord GOD , remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.

D454.title: Godspeed
D454.top: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace:
D454.bottom: before the LORD is your way wherein ye go.
D454.verse: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace: before the LORD is your way wherein ye go.

D455.title: Welcome
D455.top: And the old man said, Peace be with thee;
D455.bottom: howsoever let all thy wants lie upon me...
D455.verse: And the old man said, Peace be with thee; howsoever let all thy wants lie upon me; only lodge not in the street.

D456.title: Mourn
D456.top: ...and came unto the house of God, and wept,
D456.bottom: and sat there before the LORD...
D456.verse: Then all the children of Israel, and all the people, went up, and came unto the house of God, and wept, and sat there before the LORD, and fasted that day until even, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.

D071.title: Loyalty
D071.bottom: ...thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:
D071.verse: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

D457.title: Kinsman
D457.top: spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid;
D457.bottom: for thou art a near kinsman.
D457.verse: And he said, Who art thou? And she answered, I am Ruth thine handmaid: spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid; for thou art a near kinsman.

D458.title: Dignity
D458.top: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust,
D458.bottom: and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill...
D458.verse: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill, to set them among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory: for the pillars of the earth are the LORD’s, and he hath set the world upon them.

D459.title: Triumph
D459.top: ...behold, Dagon was fallen upon his face
D459.bottom: to the earth before the ark of the LORD.
D459.verse: And when they of Ashdod arose early on the morrow, behold, Dagon was fallen upon his face to the earth before the ark of the LORD. And they took Dagon, and set him in his place again.

D074.title: Hitherto
D074.top: ...and called the name of it Eben-ezer,
D074.bottom: saying, Hitherto hath the LORD helped us.
D074.verse: Then Samuel took a stone, and set it between Mizpeh and Shen, and called the name of it Eben-ezer, saying, Hitherto hath the LORD helped us.

D460.title: Stay
D460.top: but stand thou still a while,
D460.bottom: that I may shew thee the word of God.
D460.verse: And as they were going down to the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, Bid the servant pass on before us, (and he passed on,) but stand thou still a while, that I may shew thee the word of God.

D461.title: Rebirth
D461.top: ...when he had turned his back to go from Samuel,
D461.verse: And it was so, that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart: and all those signs came to pass that day.

D075.title: Consider
D075.top: Only fear the LORD, and serve him in truth...
D075.bottom: for consider how great things he hath done for you.
D075.verse: Only fear the LORD , and serve him in truth with all your heart: for consider how great things he hath done for you.

D462.title: Venture
D462.top: it may be that the LORD will work for us:
D462.bottom: for there is no restraint to the LORD to save...
D462.verse: And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised: it may be that the LORD will work for us: for there is no restraint to the LORD to save by many or by few.

D463.title: Knit
D463.top: the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David
D463.bottom: and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.
D463.verse: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

D464.title: Oath
D464.top: ...The LORD be between me and thee,
D464.bottom: and between my seed and thy seed for ever.
D464.verse: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD, saying, The LORD be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city. be witness of that which etc

D465.title: Captain
D465.top: And every one that was in distress... gathered
D465.bottom: themselves unto him; and he became a captain over them...
D465.verse: And every one that was in distress, and every one that was in debt, and every one that was discontented, gathered themselves unto him; and he became a captain over them: and there were with him about four hundred men.

D079.title: Uphold
D079.bottom: and went to David... and strengthened his hand in God.
D079.verse: And Jonathan Saul’s son arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.

D466.title: Advice
D466.top: And blessed be thy advice, and blessed be thou,
D466.bottom: which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood...
D466.verse: And blessed be thy advice, and blessed be thou, which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood, and from avenging myself with mine own hand.

D467.title: Refrain
D467.top: The LORD render to every man his righteousness
D467.verse: The LORD render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness: for the LORD delivered thee into my hand to day, but I would not stretch forth mine hand against the LORD’s anointed.

D468.title: Virtue
D468.top: Surely, as the LORD liveth, thou hast been upright,
D468.bottom: and thy going out and thy coming in... is good in my sight...
D468.verse: Then Achish called David, and said unto him, Surely, as the LORD liveth, thou hast been upright, and thy going out and thy coming in with me in the host is good in my sight: for I have not found evil in thee since the day of thy coming unto me unto this day: nevertheless the lords favour thee not.

D081.title: Recover
D081.verse: And David enquired at the LORD , saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them? And he answered him, Pursue: for thou shalt surely overtake them , and without fail recover all .

D082.title: Truth
D082.top: And now the LORD shew kindness
D082.verse: And now the LORD shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because ye have done this thing.

D469.title: Ascend
D469.bottom: and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.
D469.verse: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.

D470.title: Feed
D470.top: and the LORD said to thee,
D470.bottom: Thou shalt feed my people Israel...
D470.verse: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be a captain over Israel.

D471.title: Bravery
D471.top: Be of good courage, and let us play the men
D471.bottom: ...and the LORD do that which seemeth him good.
D471.verse: Be of good courage, and let us play the men for our people, and for the cities of our God: and the LORD do that which seemeth him good.

D086.title: Absolve
D086.top: I have sinned against the LORD.
D086.bottom: ...hath put away thy sin; thou shalt not die.
D086.verse: And David said unto Nathan, I have sinned against the LORD . And Nathan said unto David, The LORD also hath put away thy sin; thou shalt not die.

D472.title: Longing
D472.top: And the soul of king David longed
D472.verse: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead.

D473.title: Devise
D473.bottom: that his banished be not expelled from him.
D473.verse: For we must needs die, and are as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither doth God respect any person: yet doth he devise means, that his banished be not expelled from him.

D474.title: Submit
D474.bottom: let him do to me as seemeth good unto him.
D474.verse: But if he thus say, I have no delight in thee; behold, here am I, let him do to me as seemeth good unto him.

D475.title: Forbear
D475.top: It may be that the LORD will look on mine affliction
D475.bottom: and that the LORD will requite me good for his cursing...
D475.verse: It may be that the LORD will look on mine affliction, and that the LORD will requite me good for his cursing this day.

D087.title: Weep
D087.top: ...O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom!
D087.bottom: would God I had died for thee...
D087.verse: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had died for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!

D476.title: Clemency
D476.top: Therefore the king said unto Shimei,
D476.bottom: Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.
D476.verse: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.

D477.title: Vigil
D477.top: And Rizpah... took sackcloth, and spread it
