D477.bottom: for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest...
D477.verse: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.

D088.title: Fortress
D088.bottom: and my fortress, and my deliverer;
D088.verse: And he said, The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;

D089.title: Offering
D089.bottom: unto the LORD my God of that which doth cost me nothing.
D089.verse: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the LORD my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

D478.title: Heir
D478.top: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which hath given
D478.bottom: one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.
D478.verse: And also thus said the king, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.

D479.title: Charge
D479.top: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God,
D479.verse: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:

D091.title: Purpose
D091.bottom: unto the name of the LORD my God...
D091.verse: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name.

D480.title: Nearness
D480.top: And I will dwell among the children of Israel,
D480.bottom: and will not forsake my people Israel.
D480.verse: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.

D481.title: Firmness
D481.top: ...he set up the right pillar, and called...
D481.bottom: ...the name thereof Jachin... the left pillar... Boaz.
D481.verse: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.

D092.title: Promise
D092.verse: Blessed be the LORD , that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.

D482.title: Sanctuary
D482.top: I have hallowed this house... to put my name
D482.bottom: there for ever; and mine eyes and mine heart...
D482.verse: And the LORD said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

D483.title: Adhere
D483.top: ...if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command
D483.bottom: thee, and wilt walk in my ways... I will be with thee...
D483.verse: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.

D093.title: Servant
D093.top: If thou wilt be a servant unto this people...
D093.bottom: then they will be thy servants for ever.
D093.verse: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.

D484.title: Plea
D484.top: Intreat now the face of the LORD thy God,
D484.bottom: ...and the king's hand was restored him again...
D484.verse: And the king answered and said unto the man of God, Intreat now the face of the LORD thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God besought the LORD, and the king’s hand was restored him again, and became as it was before., and: Heb. the face of the LORD, etc

D485.title: Devoted
D485.top: ...my servant David, who kept my commandments,
D485.bottom: and who followed me with all his heart...
D485.verse: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee: and yet thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in mine eyes;

D486.title: Piety
D486.bottom: with the LORD all his days.
D486.verse: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa’s heart was perfect with the LORD all his days.

D487.title: Provider
D487.top: And the barrel of meal wasted not,
D487.bottom: neither did the cruse of oil fail...
D487.verse: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Elijah.

D488.title: Valley
D488.top: ...The LORD is God of the hills, but he is not
D488.bottom: God of the valleys... ye shall know that I am the LORD.
D488.verse: And there came a man of God, and spake unto the king of Israel, and said, Thus saith the LORD, Because the Syrians have said, The LORD is God of the hills, but he is not God of the valleys, therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand, and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

D489.title: Relent
D489.bottom: I will not bring the evil in his days...
D489.verse: Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because he humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days: but in his son’s days will I bring the evil upon his house.

D490.title: Enquire
D490.bottom: at the word of the LORD to day.
D490.verse: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.

D491.title: Await
D491.bottom: ...yet that valley shall be filled with water...
D491.verse: And he said, Thus saith the LORD, Make this valley full of ditches. For thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that ye may drink, both ye, and your cattle, and your beasts.

D492.title: Healing
D492.top: ...his flesh came again like unto the flesh
D492.bottom: of a little child, and he was clean.
D492.verse: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

D098.title: Sight
D098.top: ...LORD, I pray thee, open his eyes,
D098.bottom: that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes...
D098.verse: And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD , I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.

D493.title: Herald
D493.top: ...this day is a day of good tidings,
D493.bottom: ...come, that we may go and tell the king's household.
D493.verse: Then they said one to another, We do not well: this day is a day of good tidings, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light, some mischief will come upon us: now therefore come, that we may go and tell the king’s household.

D494.title: Reclaim
D494.top: ...Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits
D494.bottom: of the field since the day that she left the land...
D494.verse: And when the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed unto her a certain officer, saying, Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.

D495.title: Prophecy
D495.top: ...This is the word of the LORD, which he spake
D495.bottom: by his servant Elijah the Tishbite...
D495.verse: Wherefore they came again, and told him. And he said, This is the word of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel:

D496.title: Kinship
D496.top: ...Is thine heart right, as my heart is with
D496.bottom: thy heart?... If it be, give me thine hand.
D496.verse: And when he was departed thence, he lighted on Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him: and he saluted him, and said to him, Is thine heart right, as my heart is with thy heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it be, give me thine hand. And he gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.

D099.title: Pledge
D099.bottom: that they should be the LORD’s people...
D099.verse: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people, that they should be the LORD’s people; between the king also and the people.

D100.title: Favour
D100.top: And the LORD was gracious unto them,
D100.bottom: and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them...
D100.verse: And the LORD was gracious unto them, and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them, because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them, neither cast he them from his presence as yet.

D497.title: Gate
D497.bottom: of the house of the LORD.
D497.verse: Howbeit the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places. He built the higher gate of the house of the LORD.

D498.title: Fear
D498.top: But the LORD your God ye shall fear;
D498.bottom: and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.
D498.verse: But the LORD your God ye shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.

D101.title: Cling
D101.top: For he clave to the LORD,
D101.bottom: and departed not from following him...
D101.verse: For he clave to the LORD , and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses.

D499.title: Unburden
D499.top: ...Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD,
D499.bottom: and spread it before the LORD.
D499.verse: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.

D500.title: Discover
D500.top: ...I have found the book of the law
D500.bottom: in the house of the LORD...
D500.verse: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

D501.title: Might
D501.top: ...that turned to the LORD with all his heart,
D501.bottom: and with all his soul, and with all his might...
D501.verse: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.

D103.title: Lift
D103.top: ...did lift up the head of Jehoiachin
D103.bottom: king of Judah out of prison;
D103.verse: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;

D503.title: Ancestry
D503.top: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
D503.bottom: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,
D503.verse: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz, And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,

D104.title: Enlarge
D104.top: ...Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed,
D104.bottom: and enlarge my coast... that thine hand might be with me...
D104.verse: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.

D106.title: Song
D106.top: ...David set over the service of song
D106.bottom: in the house of the LORD...
D106.verse: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD , after that the ark had rest.

D504.title: Console
D504.top: And Ephraim their father mourned many days,
D504.bottom: and his brethren came to comfort him.
D504.verse: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.

D505.title: Sentinel
D505.top: And they lodged round about the house of God,
D505.bottom: ...and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.
D505.verse: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.

D506.title: Yearning
D506.top: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would
D506.bottom: give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem...
D506.verse: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem, that is at the gate!

D107.title: Discern
D107.top: ...men that had understanding of the times,
D107.bottom: to know what Israel ought to do...
D107.verse: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.

D507.title: Music
D507.bottom: psalteries and harps... lifting up the voice with joy.
D507.verse: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.

D109.title: Protect
D109.verse: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David’s servants. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

D508.title: Cost
D508.top: ...I will not take that which is thine for the LORD,
D508.bottom: nor offer burnt offerings without cost.
D508.verse: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is thine for the LORD, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.

D110.title: Morning
D110.bottom: to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at even;
D110.verse: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD , and likewise at even;

D509.title: Harp
D509.bottom: to give thanks and to praise the LORD.
D509.verse: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the LORD.

D510.title: Minister
D510.bottom: ...to minister in the house of the LORD.
D510.verse: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the LORD.

D111.title: Devotion
D111.top: ...know thou the God of thy father,
D111.bottom: and serve him with a perfect heart...
D111.verse: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.

D113.title: Majesty
D113.top: Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power,
D113.bottom: and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty...
D113.verse: Thine, O LORD , is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O LORD , and thou art exalted as head above all.

D511.title: Infinity
D511.top: ...seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens
D511.verse: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who am I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?

D512.title: Harmony
D512.top: ...the trumpeters and singers were as one,
D512.bottom: to make one sound to be heard in praising... the LORD...
D512.verse: It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised the LORD, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: that then the house was filled with a cloud, even the house of the LORD;

D513.title: Goodness
D513.top: ...let thy priests, O LORD God, be clothed
D513.bottom: with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.
D513.verse: Now therefore arise, O LORD God, into thy resting place, thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.

D115.title: Justice
D115.verse: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, to be king for the LORD thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.

D514.title: Grant
D514.bottom: I will not destroy them, but I will grant them...
D514.verse: And when the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

D116.title: Lean
D116.bottom: and in thy name we go against this multitude...
D116.verse: And Asa cried unto the LORD his God, and said, LORD , it is nothing with thee to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O LORD our God; for we rest on thee, and in thy name we go against this multitude. O LORD , thou art our God; let not man prevail against thee.

D117.title: Reward
D117.bottom: for your work shall be rewarded.
D117.verse: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.

D515.title: Equality
D515.top: ...for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God,
D515.bottom: nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.
D515.verse: Wherefore now let the fear of the LORD be upon you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.

D118.title: Eyes
D118.bottom: but our eyes are upon thee.
D118.verse: O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon thee.

D516.title: Hide
D516.top: ...Jehoshabeath... took Joash the son of Ahaziah,
D516.bottom: ...hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.
D516.verse: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king’s sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, (for she was the sister of Ahaziah,) hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.

D517.title: Repair
D517.top: And it came to pass after this, that Joash
D517.bottom: was minded to repair the house of the LORD.
D517.verse: And it came to pass after this, that Joash was minded to repair the house of the LORD.

D120.title: Thrive
D120.top: ...as long as he sought the LORD,
D120.verse: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God: and as long as he sought the LORD , God made him to prosper.

D518.title: Care
D518.top: ...with the spoil clothed all that were naked
D518.bottom: ...and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them...
D518.verse: And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then they returned to Samaria.

D519.title: Trumpet
D519.top: ...when the burnt offering began, the song
D519.bottom: of the LORD began also with the trumpets...
D519.verse: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering upon the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD began also with the trumpets, and with the instruments ordained by David king of Israel.

D122.title: Defend
D122.top: ...but with us is the LORD our God
D122.bottom: to help us, and to fight our battles...
D122.verse: With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

D520.title: Entreat
D520.top: And when he was in affliction, he besought
D520.bottom: the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly...
D520.verse: And when he was in affliction, he besought the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers,

D521.title: Youth
D521.top: ...while he was yet young, he began to seek
D521.bottom: after the God of David his father...
D521.verse: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.

D522.title: Festival
D522.verse: Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto the LORD in Jerusalem: and they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

D123.title: Raise
D123.top: ...all them whose spirit God had raised,
D123.bottom: to go up to build the house of the LORD...
D123.verse: Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all them whose spirit God had raised, to go up to build the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem.

D523.title: Homeward
D523.top: ...and came again unto Jerusalem and Judah,
D523.verse: Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity, of those which had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon, and came again unto Jerusalem and Judah, every one unto his city;

D124.title: Exalt
D124.top: ...all the people shouted with a great shout,
D124.verse: And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto the LORD ; because he is good, for his mercy endureth for ever toward Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the LORD , because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid.

D524.title: Dedicate
D524.bottom: the dedication of this house of God with joy,
D524.verse: And the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy,

D125.title: Prepare
D125.top: For Ezra had prepared his heart
D125.bottom: to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it...
D125.verse: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD , and to do it , and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.

D126.title: Fast
D126.top: So we fasted and besought our God for this:
D126.bottom: and he was intreated of us.
D126.verse: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.

D525.title: Respite
D525.top: ...grace hath been shewed from the LORD our God,
D525.bottom: to leave us a remnant to escape...
D525.verse: And now for a little space grace hath been shewed from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.

D128.title: Champion
D128.bottom: our God shall fight for us.
D128.verse: In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet, resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us.

D526.title: Tenacity
D526.bottom: so that I cannot come down...
D526.verse: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?

D527.title: Inspire
D527.top: And my God put into mine heart
D527.bottom: to gather together the nobles, and the rulers...
D527.verse: And my God put into mine heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. And I found a register of the genealogy of them which came up at the first, and found written therein,

D528.title: Mercies
D528.top: Yet many years didst thou forbear them...
D528.bottom: ...for thou art a gracious and merciful God.
D528.verse: Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands. Nevertheless for thy great mercies’ sake thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for thou art a gracious and merciful God.

D529.title: Freewill
D529.top: And the people blessed all the men,
D529.bottom: that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.
D529.verse: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.

D530.title: Resound
D530.top: ...God had made them rejoice with great joy...
D530.bottom: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.
D530.verse: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.

D130.title: Blessing
D130.verse: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.

D531.title: Adopt
D531.top: ...whom Mordecai, when her father and mother
D531.bottom: were dead, took for his own daughter.
D531.verse: And he brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther, his uncle’s daughter: for she had neither father nor mother, and the maid was fair and beautiful; whom Mordecai, when her father and mother were dead, took for his own daughter.

D132.title: Approach
D132.bottom: and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre...
D132.verse: And it was so, when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, that she obtained favour in his sight: and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that was in his hand. So Esther drew near, and touched the top of the sceptre.

D133.title: Gladness
D133.bottom: and gladness, and joy, and honour.
D133.verse: The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.

D134.title: Name
D134.top: ...the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away;
D134.bottom: blessed be the name of the LORD.
D134.verse: And said, Naked came I out of my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD .

D135.title: Commit
D135.bottom: and unto God would I commit my cause...
D135.verse: I would seek unto God, and unto God would I commit my cause:

D136.title: Increase
D136.bottom: yet thy latter end should greatly increase.
D136.verse: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.

D532.title: Fashion
D532.bottom: and fashioned me together round about...
D532.verse: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.

D137.title: Counsel
D137.top: With him is wisdom and strength,
D137.verse: With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.

D138.title: Witness
D138.top: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven,
D138.bottom: and my record is on high.
D138.verse: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.

D533.title: Creation
D533.top: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place,
D533.bottom: and hangeth the earth upon nothing.
D533.verse: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.

D142.title: Awe
D142.top: ...Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom;
D142.bottom: and to depart from evil is understanding.
D142.verse: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.

D534.title: Insight
D534.top: But there is a spirit in man:
D534.bottom: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
D534.verse: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.

D143.title: Ransom
D143.top: Deliver him from going down to the pit:
D143.verse: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.

D144.title: Plenty
D144.top: If they obey and serve him,
D144.bottom: they shall spend their days in prosperity...
D144.verse: If they obey and serve him , they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

D535.title: Chorus
D535.top: When the morning stars sang together,
D535.bottom: and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
D535.verse: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

D536.title: Mighty
D536.top: I know that thou canst do every thing,
D536.bottom: and that no thought can be withholden from thee.
D536.verse: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.

D149.title: Confide
D149.top: And they that know thy name
D149.bottom: will put their trust in thee...
D149.verse: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD , hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

D150.title: Purify
D150.top: The words of the LORD are pure words:
D150.bottom: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
D150.verse: The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

D152.title: Heavens
D152.top: The heavens declare the glory of God;
D152.bottom: and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
D152.verse: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

D156.title: Dawn
D156.bottom: but joy cometh in the morning.
D156.verse: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

D537.title: Steps
D537.top: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD:
D537.bottom: and he delighteth in his way.
D537.verse: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.

D158.title: Hymn
D158.top: And he hath put a new song in my mouth,
D158.verse: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it , and fear, and shall trust in the LORD .

D163.title: Sustain
D163.top: Cast thy burden upon the LORD,
D163.verse: Cast thy burden upon the LORD , and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

D164.title: Shelter
D164.top: ...yea, in the shadow of thy wings
D164.bottom: will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
D164.verse: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.

D167.title: Father
D167.bottom: and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
D167.verse: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

D169.title: Heritage
D169.top: My flesh and my heart faileth:
D169.bottom: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
D169.verse: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

D538.title: Meditate
D538.top: I will meditate also of all thy work,
D538.verse: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.

D170.title: Flock
D170.top: But made his own people to go forth like sheep,
D170.bottom: and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
D170.verse: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

D171.title: Supply
D171.top: I am the LORD thy God...
D171.bottom: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
D171.verse: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

D172.title: Awaken
D172.top: Wilt thou not revive us again:
D172.bottom: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
D172.verse: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

D539.title: Proclaim
D539.top: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name:
D539.bottom: make known his deeds among the people.
D539.verse: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

D179.title: Satisfy
D179.top: For he satisfieth the longing soul,
D179.bottom: and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
D179.verse: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

D180.title: Release
D180.top: He sent redemption unto his people:
D180.bottom: he hath commanded his covenant for ever...
D180.verse: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.

D181.title: Uplift
D181.top: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust,
D181.bottom: and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill...
D181.verse: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

D184.title: Hills
D184.top: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills,
D184.verse: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

D187.title: Unity
D187.top: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is
D187.bottom: for brethren to dwell together in unity!
D187.verse: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

D190.title: Upright
D190.top: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God:
D190.bottom: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
D190.verse: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.

D540.title: Labour
D540.top: Go to the ant, thou sluggard;
D540.bottom: consider her ways, and be wise...
D540.verse: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:

D194.title: Watch
D194.top: Blessed is the man that heareth me,
D194.verse: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.

D196.title: Generous
D196.top: The liberal soul shall be made fat:
D196.bottom: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
D196.verse: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

D541.title: Soothe
D541.top: A soft answer turneth away wrath:
D541.bottom: but grievous words stir up anger.
D541.verse: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

D199.title: Train
D199.top: Train up a child in the way he should go:
D199.bottom: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
D199.verse: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.

D542.title: Entrust
D542.top: My son, give me thine heart,
D542.bottom: and let thine eyes observe my ways.
D542.verse: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.

D543.title: News
D543.top: As cold waters to a thirsty soul,
D543.bottom: so is good news from a far country.
D543.verse: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

D200.title: Friend
D200.bottom: so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
D200.verse: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

D201.title: Purity
D201.top: Every word of God is pure:
D201.bottom: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
D201.verse: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.

D203.title: Partner
D203.bottom: ...if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow...
D203.verse: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.

D204.title: Patience
D204.top: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning...
D204.bottom: ...the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
D204.verse: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.

D544.title: Vigour
D544.top: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do,
D544.verse: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.

D205.title: Creator
D205.bottom: in the days of thy youth...
D205.verse: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;

D207.title: Beloved
D207.top: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine:
D207.verse: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine: he feedeth among the lilies.

D545.title: Disarm
D545.top: they shall beat their swords into plowshares,
D545.verse: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

D212.title: Draw
D212.top: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water
D212.bottom: out of the wells of salvation.
D212.verse: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.

D546.title: Relief
D546.top: the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow,
D546.verse: And it shall come to pass in the day that the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,

D213.title: Maker
D213.top: At that day shall a man look to his Maker,
D213.bottom: and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.
D213.verse: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.

D214.title: Key
D214.top: And the key of the house of David...
D214.bottom: ...so he shall open, and none shall shut...
D214.verse: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.

D547.title: Acclaim
D547.top: They shall lift up their voice,
D547.bottom: they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD...
D547.verse: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.

D217.title: Stone
D217.top: Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone,
D217.bottom: a tried stone, a precious corner stone...
D217.verse: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD , Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone , a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.

D216.title: Quiet
D216.top: In returning and rest shall ye be saved;
D216.bottom: in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength...
D216.verse: For thus saith the Lord GOD , the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.

D218.title: Shadow
D218.top: ...as rivers of water in a dry place,
D218.bottom: as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
D218.verse: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.

D219.title: Pilgrim
D219.top: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return,
D219.bottom: and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy...
D219.verse: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

D548.title: Petition
D548.top: Hezekiah went up unto the house of the LORD,
D548.bottom: and spread it before the LORD.
D548.verse: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.

D549.title: Grasp
D549.top: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand,
D549.bottom: saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
D549.verse: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.

D222.title: Support
D222.top: And even to your old age I am he;
D222.bottom: and even to hoar hairs will I carry you...
D222.verse: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you .

D550.title: Crucible
D550.top: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver;
D550.bottom: I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.
D550.verse: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.

D551.title: Engrave
D551.top: I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands;
D551.bottom: thy walls are continually before me.
D551.verse: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.

D224.title: Tidings
D224.top: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet
D224.bottom: of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace...
D224.verse: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!

D552.title: Oasis
D552.top: And the LORD shall guide thee continually,...
D552.bottom: thou shalt be like a watered garden...
D552.verse: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.

D227.title: Jewel
D227.top: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory
D227.bottom: in the hand of the LORD...
D227.verse: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD , and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.

D553.title: Potter
D553.top: But now, O LORD, thou art our father;
D553.bottom: we are the clay, and thou our potter...
D553.verse: But now, O LORD, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.

D554.title: Mother
D554.top: As one whom his mother comforteth,
D554.verse: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.

D228.title: Fountain
D228.verse: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.

D555.title: Pastor
D555.top: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart,
D555.bottom: which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.
D555.verse: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.

D229.title: Soul
D229.top: ...ask for the old paths, where is the good way,
D229.bottom: and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls.
D229.verse: Thus saith the LORD , Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein .

D231.title: People
D231.top: Obey my voice, and I will be your God,
D231.bottom: and ye shall be my people...
D231.verse: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people: and walk ye in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.

D230.title: Boast
D230.top: ...let him that glorieth glory in this,
D230.bottom: that he understandeth and knoweth me...
D230.verse: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the LORD .

D556.title: Endure
D556.top: If thou hast run with the footmen,
D556.bottom: and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend...
D556.verse: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein thou trustedst, they wearied thee, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?

D232.title: Emmanuel
D232.bottom: art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name...
D232.verse: Why shouldest thou be as a man astonied, as a mighty man that cannot save? yet thou, O LORD , art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not.

D557.title: Relish
D557.top: Thy words were found, and I did eat them;
D557.bottom: and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing...
D557.verse: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.

D558.title: Ablaze
D558.top: But his word was in mine heart
D558.bottom: as a burning fire shut up in my bones...
D558.verse: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not stay.

D559.title: Pathway
D559.bottom: the way of life, and the way of death.
D559.verse: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.

D235.title: Branch
D235.top: ...I will raise unto David a righteous Branch,
D235.bottom: and a King shall reign and prosper...
D235.verse: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD , that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.

D560.title: Goodwill
D560.top: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good,
D560.bottom: and I will bring them again to this land...
D560.verse: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.

D236.title: Amend
D236.top: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings,
D236.bottom: and obey the voice of the LORD your God...
D236.verse: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the LORD your God; and the LORD will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.

D561.title: Bestow
D561.top: I have made the earth... by my outstretched arm,
D561.bottom: and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.
D561.verse: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that are upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.

D562.title: Inscribe
D562.top: I will put my law in their inward parts,
D562.bottom: and write it in their hearts...
D562.verse: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the LORD, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.

D563.title: Freedom
D563.top: and had done right in my sight,
D563.bottom: in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour...
D563.verse: And ye were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:

D564.title: Scroll
D564.bottom: and write in it all the former words...
D564.verse: Take thee again another roll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah hath burned.

D240.title: Safety
D240.top: For I will surely deliver thee...
D240.bottom: ...because thou hast put thy trust in me, saith the LORD.
D240.verse: For I will surely deliver thee, and thou shalt not fall by the sword, but thy life shall be for a prey unto thee: because thou hast put thy trust in me, saith the LORD .

D565.title: Unchain
D565.top: And now, behold, I loose thee this day
D565.bottom: from the chains which were upon thine hand...
D565.verse: And now, behold, I loose thee this day from the chains which were upon thine hand. If it seem good unto thee to come with me into Babylon, come; and I will look well unto thee: but if it seem ill unto thee to come with me into Babylon, forbear: behold, all the land is before thee: whither it seemeth good and convenient for thee to go, thither go.

D241.title: Plant
D241.top: ...then will I build you, and not pull you down,
D241.bottom: and I will plant you, and not pluck you up...
D241.verse: If ye will still abide in this land, then will I build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up: for I repent me of the evil that I have done unto you.

D566.title: Implore
D566.top: I sent unto you all my servants the prophets,
D566.verse: Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending them, saying, Oh, do not this abominable thing that I hate.

D242.title: Fearless
D242.top: Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the LORD:
D242.verse: Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the LORD : for I am with thee; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee: but I will not make a full end of thee, but correct thee in measure; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished.

D567.title: Reprieve
D567.top: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab
D567.bottom: in the latter days, saith the LORD...
D567.verse: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the LORD. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.

D568.title: Orphan
D568.bottom: I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.
D568.verse: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.

D243.title: Erase
D243.top: ...the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for,
D243.bottom: and there shall be none... for I will pardon them...
D243.verse: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD , the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.

D569.title: Recount
D569.top: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness:
D569.bottom: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.
D569.verse: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.

D570.title: Table
D570.bottom: and he did continually eat bread before him...
D570.verse: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.

D571.title: Sorrow
D571.top: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by?
D571.bottom: behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow...
D571.verse: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.

D246.title: Throne
D246.top: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever;
D246.bottom: thy throne from generation to generation.
D246.verse: Thou, O LORD , remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.

D247.title: Watchman
D247.top: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman
D247.bottom: ...therefore hear the word at my mouth...
D247.verse: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.

D572.title: Bearer
D572.top: according to the number of the days
D572.bottom: that thou shalt lie upon it thou shalt bear their iniquity.
D572.verse: Lie thou also upon thy left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it: according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon it thou shalt bear their iniquity.

D573.title: Survivor
D573.top: Yet will I leave a remnant,
D573.bottom: that ye may have some that shall escape the sword...
D573.verse: Yet will I leave a remnant, that ye may have some that shall escape the sword among the nations, when ye shall be scattered through the countries.

D574.title: Token
D574.top: and set a mark upon the foreheads
D574.bottom: of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations...
D574.verse: And the LORD said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.

D575.title: Decree
D575.top: For I am the LORD: I will speak,
D575.bottom: and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass...
D575.verse: For I am the LORD: I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord GOD.

D576.title: Forsake
D576.top: Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols;
D576.bottom: and turn away your faces from all your abominations.
D576.verse: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.

D250.title: Bond
D250.top: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant...
D250.bottom: ...and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.
D250.verse: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.

D577.title: Cedar
D577.top: In the mountain of the height of Israel...
D577.bottom: ...bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar...
D577.verse: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.

D578.title: Hallmark
D578.top: I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign
D578.bottom: between me and them... that I am the LORD that sanctify them.
D578.verse: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am the LORD that sanctify them.

D579.title: Monarch
D579.top: and it shall be no more, until he come
D579.bottom: whose right it is; and I will give it him.
D579.verse: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it him.

D580.title: Turning
D580.bottom: and cast me behind thy back...
D580.verse: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

D581.title: Example
D581.top: and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb:
D581.bottom: and thou shalt be a sign unto them...
D581.verse: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: and thou shalt be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.

D582.title: Grandeur
D582.bottom: in the land of the living.
D582.verse: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;

D254.title: Vineyard
D254.top: ...and shall build houses, and plant vineyards;
D254.bottom: yea, they shall dwell with confidence...
D254.verse: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I am the LORD their God.

D583.title: Eden
D583.bottom: so that all the trees of Eden... in the garden of God...
D583.verse: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches: so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied him.

D584.title: Serenity
D584.top: Then will I make their waters deep,
D584.bottom: and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord GOD.
D584.verse: Then will I make their waters deep, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord GOD.

D255.title: Forget
D255.top: None of his sins that he hath committed
D255.bottom: shall be mentioned unto him...he shall surely live.
D255.verse: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.

D585.title: Newness
D585.top: A new heart also will I give you,
D585.bottom: and a new spirit will I put within you...
D585.verse: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.

D257.title: Alive
D257.top: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live,
D257.bottom: and I shall place you in your own land...
D257.verse: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the LORD have spoken it , and performed it , saith the LORD .

D586.title: Unveil
D586.top: Neither will I hide my face any more from them:
D586.bottom: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel...
D586.verse: Neither will I hide my face any more from them: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.

D587.title: Observe
D587.top: behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears,
D587.bottom: and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee...
D587.verse: And the man said unto me, Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee; for to the intent that I might shew them unto thee art thou brought hither: declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel.

D588.title: Sacred
D588.top: it had a wall round about...
D588.bottom: to make a separation between the sanctuary...
D588.verse: He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall round about, five hundred reeds long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.

D258.title: Voice
D258.top: ...and his voice was like a noise of many waters:
D258.bottom: and the earth shined with his glory.
D258.verse: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.

D259.title: Holiness
D259.top: And they shall teach my people
D259.bottom: the difference between the holy and profane...
D259.verse: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.

D589.title: Balance
D589.bottom: and a just ephah, and a just bath.
D589.verse: Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.

D261.title: Resolve
D261.top: But Daniel purposed in his heart
D261.bottom: that he would not defile himself...
D261.verse: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king’s meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

D590.title: Secrets
D590.top: He revealeth the deep and secret things:
D590.bottom: he knoweth what is in the darkness...
D590.verse: He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knoweth what is in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.

D591.title: Furnace
D591.top: I see four men... walking in the midst of the fire,
D591.bottom: and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.
D591.verse: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.

D592.title: Extol
D592.top: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol
D592.bottom: and honour the King of heaven, all whose works are truth...
D592.verse: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven, all whose works are truth, and his ways judgment: and those that walk in pride he is able to abase.

D593.title: Breath
D593.top: and the God in whose hand thy breath is,
D593.bottom: and whose are all thy ways, hast thou not glorified...
D593.verse: But hast lifted up thyself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before thee, and thou, and thy lords, thy wives, and thy concubines, have drunk wine in them; and thou hast praised the gods of silver, and gold, of brass, iron, wood, and stone, which see not, nor hear, nor know: and the God in whose hand thy breath is, and whose are all thy ways, hast thou not glorified:

D594.title: Dominion
D594.top: his dominion is an everlasting dominion,
D594.verse: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.

D595.title: Touch
D595.top: I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground:
D595.bottom: but he touched me, and set me upright.
D595.verse: Now as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright.

D263.title: Strong
D263.top: O man greatly beloved, fear not:
D263.bottom: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong.
D263.verse: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.

D596.title: Exploits
D596.top: but the people that do know their God
D596.bottom: shall be strong, and do exploits.
D596.verse: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.

D264.title: Star
D264.bottom: as the stars for ever and ever.
D264.verse: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.

D265.title: Pursue
D265.top: ...if we follow on to know the LORD:
D265.bottom: his going forth is prepared as the morning...
D265.verse: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the LORD : his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.

D597.title: Grapes
D597.top: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness;
D597.bottom: I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree...
D597.verse: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baal-peor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.

D267.title: Sow
D267.top: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy;
D267.bottom: ...for it is time to seek the LORD...
D267.verse: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the LORD , till he come and rain righteousness upon you.

D268.title: Dew
D268.top: I will be as the dew unto Israel:
D268.bottom: he shall grow as the lily...
D268.verse: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.

D598.title: Agree
D598.verse: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?

D270.title: Equity
D270.top: But let judgment run down as waters,
D270.bottom: and righteousness as a mighty stream.
D270.verse: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.

D599.title: Hunger
D599.top: not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water,
D599.bottom: but of hearing the words of the LORD...
D599.verse: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord GOD, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the LORD:

D600.title: Empower
D600.top: But truly I am full of power
D600.bottom: by the spirit of the LORD, and of judgment, and of might...
D600.verse: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the LORD, and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.

D601.title: Modesty
D601.top: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good;
D601.bottom: ...to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
D601.verse: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

D602.title: Exult
D602.top: Although the fig tree shall not blossom...
D602.bottom: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD...
D602.verse: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.

D603.title: Signet
D603.top: and will make thee as a signet:
D603.bottom: for I have chosen thee, saith the LORD of hosts.
D603.verse: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, will I take thee, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, saith the LORD, and will make thee as a signet: for I have chosen thee, saith the LORD of hosts.

D279.title: Wall
D279.top: ...will be unto her a wall of fire round about,
D279.bottom: and will be the glory in the midst of her.
D279.verse: For I, saith the LORD , will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.

D604.title: Small
D604.top: For who hath despised the day of small things?
D604.verse: For who hath despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of the LORD, which run to and fro through the whole earth. shall rejoice

D281.title: Honesty
D281.top: Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour;
D281.bottom: execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates...
D281.verse: These are the things that ye shall do; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:

D283.title: Spring
D283.top: In that day there shall be a fountain opened
D283.verse: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness.

D605.title: Evening
D605.top: but it shall come to pass,
D605.bottom: that at evening time it shall be light.
D605.verse: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the LORD, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light.

D606.title: Refiner
D606.top: And he shall sit as a refiner
D606.verse: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the LORD an offering in righteousness.

D284.title: Jesus
D284.bottom: for he shall save his people from their sins.
D284.verse: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.

D607.title: Cure
D607.top: Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him,
D607.bottom: saying, I will; be thou clean.
D607.verse: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

D288.title: Yoke
D288.top: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me;
D288.bottom: ...and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
D288.verse: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.

D608.title: Gentle
D608.top: A bruised reed shall he not break,
D608.bottom: and smoking flax shall he not quench...
D608.verse: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.

D609.title: Pearl
D609.top: when he had found one pearl of great price,
D609.bottom: went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
D609.verse: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

D610.title: Lifeline
D610.verse: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?

D611.title: Midst
D611.top: For where two or three are gathered together
D611.bottom: in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
D611.verse: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

D612.title: Service
D612.top: the Son of man came not to be ministered unto,
D612.bottom: but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
D612.verse: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

D291.title: Hosanna
D291.top: Hosanna to the Son of David:
D291.bottom: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord...
D291.verse: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.

D613.title: Render
D613.top: Render therefore unto Cæsar the things...
D613.bottom: and unto God the things that are God's.
D613.verse: They say unto him, Cæsar’s. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Cæsar the things which are Cæsar’s; and unto God the things that are God’s.

D614.title: Stamina
D614.top: But he that shall endure unto the end,
D614.verse: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

D292.title: Steward
D292.top: Well done, thou good and faithful servant:
D292.bottom: ...enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
D292.verse: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

D615.title: Consent
D615.bottom: not as I will, but as thou wilt.
D615.verse: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.

D616.title: Access
D616.top: And, behold, the veil of the temple
D616.bottom: was rent in twain from the top to the bottom...
D616.verse: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;

D617.title: Family
D617.top: For whosoever shall do the will of God,
D617.bottom: the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
D617.verse: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.

D295.title: Calm
D295.top: ...and said unto the sea, Peace, be still.
D295.bottom: And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
D295.verse: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

D618.title: Restored
D618.top: Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole;
D618.bottom: go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
D618.verse: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.

D619.title: Retreat
D619.top: Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place,
D619.verse: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

D620.title: Deny
D620.top: Whosoever will come after me, let him deny
D620.bottom: himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
D620.verse: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

D621.title: Receive
D621.top: Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God
D621.bottom: as a little child, he shall not enter therein.
D621.verse: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.

D622.title: House
D622.top: My house shall be called of all nations
D622.verse: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.

D623.title: Adore
D623.top: love the Lord thy God with all thy heart,
D623.bottom: and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind...
D623.verse: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.

D624.title: Publish
D624.top: And the gospel must first be published
D624.verse: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.

D297.title: Abba
D297.top: Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee;
D297.bottom: ...nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
D297.verse: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.

D625.title: Announce
D625.top: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter
D625.bottom: that he goeth before you into Galilee...
D625.verse: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.

D626.title: Handmaid
D626.top: Behold the handmaid of the Lord;
D626.bottom: be it unto me according to thy word.
D626.verse: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.

D627.title: Impart
D627.top: He that hath two coats, let him impart
D627.verse: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.

D628.title: Captives
D628.top: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me...
D628.bottom: to preach deliverance to the captives...
D628.verse: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,

D629.title: Lend
D629.top: But love ye your enemies, and do good,
D629.bottom: and lend, hoping for nothing again...
D629.verse: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.

D630.title: Tears
D630.top: And stood at his feet behind him weeping,
D630.bottom: and began to wash his feet with tears...
D630.verse: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

D631.title: Candle
D631.top: No man, when he hath lighted a candle...
D631.verse: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.

D300.title: Cross
D300.top: If any man will come after me,
D300.bottom: let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily...
D300.verse: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

D301.title: Harvest
D301.verse: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.

D632.title: Hallowed
D632.top: Our Father which art in heaven,
D632.bottom: Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come.
D632.verse: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.

D302.title: Priority
D302.bottom: there will your heart be also.
D302.verse: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

D633.title: Strive
D633.verse: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.

D634.title: Mustard
D634.top: If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed,
D634.bottom: ye might say unto this sycamine tree...
D634.verse: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.

D635.title: Sinner
D635.bottom: God be merciful to me a sinner.
D635.verse: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.

D304.title: Save
D304.top: For the Son of man is come
D304.bottom: to seek and to save that which was lost.
D304.verse: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

D636.title: Living
D636.top: For he is not a God of the dead,
D636.bottom: but of the living: for all live unto him.
D636.verse: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.

D637.title: Upward
D637.top: then look up, and lift up your heads;
D637.verse: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.

D638.title: Brethren
D638.top: I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not:
D638.bottom: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
D638.verse: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.

D639.title: Paradise
D639.top: Verily I say unto thee, To day
D639.bottom: shalt thou be with me in paradise.
D639.verse: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.

D640.title: Kindle
D640.top: Did not our heart burn within us,
D640.bottom: while he talked with us by the way...
D640.verse: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?

D305.title: Lamb
D305.bottom: which taketh away the sin of the world.
D305.verse: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.

D641.title: Eternity
D641.top: the water that I shall give him shall be in him
D641.bottom: a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
D641.verse: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

D642.title: Rise
D642.bottom: Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
D642.verse: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.

D643.title: Wanted
D643.top: and him that cometh to me
D643.bottom: I will in no wise cast out.
D643.verse: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

D644.title: Drink
D644.bottom: let him come unto me, and drink.
D644.verse: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.

D308.title: See
D308.bottom: that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
D308.verse: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no , I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

D309.title: Life
D309.top: I am the resurrection, and the life:
D309.bottom: he that believeth in me... yet shall he live:
D309.verse: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

D645.title: Wheat
D645.top: Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground...
D645.bottom: if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
D645.verse: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.

D646.title: Mansion
D646.top: In my Father's house are many mansions...
D646.bottom: I go to prepare a place for you.
D646.verse: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

D647.title: Sanctity
D647.verse: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.

D313.title: Christ
D313.top: ...there is none other name under heaven
